author: Rasmus Therkelsen
name: Flowly AI Agent Skills
description: Installs Flowly AI agent skills for Claude Code (.claude/skills/) or GitHub Copilot CLI (.github/skills/) in the current directory.

agent.description: The AI coding agent the skills are installed for. 'claude' installs into .claude/skills/ (Claude Code; GitHub Copilot CLI also reads this folder). 'copilot' installs into .github/skills/ (GitHub Copilot CLI's own project skills folder).
